responses.title: Multi-metric overview
responses.summary: AEGIS now carries governed accuracy metrics for more than one metric, each keeping its own identity so variants are never blended.
responses.what_the_evidence_says: Every normalized row declares metric_id, db_type, scenario, granularity, entity_key and forecast_version, and every ranking group is isolated by that same tuple.
responses.why_it_matters: Without this identity the dashboard silently averaged different series together.
limitations: Availability differs per metric. Several metrics are not yet located in the source.

claims_traceability.claim: Each metric keeps a separate identity
Rankings never merge two source objects

download_payload.body: AEGIS now carries governed accuracy metrics for more than one metric, each keeping its own identity so variants are never blended.

responses.title: Why single-version accuracy is not drift
responses.summary: When only one forecast version is retained, the evidence supports point accuracy for that cycle and nothing about change over time.
responses.what_the_evidence_says: Drift requires at least two comparable forecast versions. The contract sets drift_computable to false whenever a source retains one version.
responses.why_it_matters: Calling it drift would imply a trend that the data cannot support.
limitations: This limitation is a property of source retention, not of the analysis method.

download_payload.body: When only one forecast version is retained, the evidence supports point accuracy for that cycle and nothing about change over time.

responses.title: Why drift is or is not computable
responses.summary: Drift is only offered when a source retains two or more comparable forecast versions and the compared rows share one unit.
responses.what_the_evidence_says: hdd_edb/EDB at region grain: drift_computable=True because NO_TARGET_DATE_GRAIN|NO_FORECAST_FACT_TABLE|SHINY_NOT_CONNECTED; hdd_edb/EDB at forest grain: drift_computable=True because NO_TARGET_DATE_GRAIN|NO_FORECAST_FACT_TABLE|SHINY_NOT_CONNECTED; ssd_phoenix/lv_with_efficiency at forest grain: drift_computable=False because SINGLE_VERSION_ONLY|NO_TARGET_DATE_GRAIN|NO_FORECAST_FACT_TABLE|SHINY_NOT_CONNECTED; ssd_phoenix/lv_no_efficiency at forest grain: drift_computable=False because SINGLE_VERSION_ONLY|NO_TARGET_DATE_GRAIN|NO_FORECAST_FACT_TABLE|SHINY_NOT_CONNECTED; hdd_edb/EDB at region grain: drift_computable=False because NO_ACTUALS|SINGLE_VERSION_ONLY|SHINY_NOT_CONNECTED
responses.why_it_matters: It stops a one-cycle measurement from being read as a movement between plans.
limitations: Capability is declared by the producer and the dashboard must not override it.

claims_traceability.claim: Drift availability is declared per source

responses.title: Why same-metric variants are reported separately
responses.summary: Metrics ssd_phoenix expose more than one variant that shares the same key and forecast version: lv_no_efficiency, lv_with_efficiency. They are reported side by side and never pooled.
responses.what_the_evidence_says: Grouping by key and version alone merged them. The ranking key now includes db_type and every group asserts a single source object.
responses.why_it_matters: A blended average corresponds to no real series and would misinform the review.
limitations: The final classification of these variants is a pending stakeholder decision.

download_payload.body: Metrics ssd_phoenix expose more than one variant that shares the same key and forecast version: lv_no_efficiency, lv_with_efficiency. They are reported side by side and never pooled.

responses.title: Why values are not combined across metrics
responses.summary: Raw business values are never aggregated across metrics because their units differ and none of the units is verified yet.
responses.what_the_evidence_says: Every row carries a unit and a unit_status. Storage, compute and rate measures are not additive, and a ranking group must resolve to exactly one unit.
responses.why_it_matters: Summing across metrics would produce a number with no physical meaning.
limitations: Units remain UNKNOWN pending the data engineering confirmation.

claims_traceability.claim: Cross metric raw aggregation is blocked
